title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1970-10-04
source: Lineage unknown. Thanks to Barry Smith.

ai_review.summary: Good-quality broadcast capture featuring the Dead and Jefferson Airplane with historic Janis Joplin death announcement
ai_review.review: The recording is an interesting radio broadcast from San Francisco in 1970 that mixes a Grateful Dead set with Jefferson Airplane, and it famously includes the first on‑air news of Janis Joplin’s death. Reviewers gave it four stars, indicating they found the content compelling despite no specific comments about audio fidelity.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one moderately positive review (4 ★) with limited detail; rating reflects a good but not exceptional show and unknown recording quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No explicit comments on clarity or mix; presumed acceptable broadcast quality.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Broadcast blends Dead material with Jefferson Airplane; notable for the historic Janis Joplin death announcement rather than musical flow.
